title: Social Icons
slide_intent: Show how to adapt an avatar to a platform mask or temporary occasion while retaining its silhouette.
strategic_value: A stable carrot shape can give seasonal variations a visible link to the primary identity.
demonstration: Twelve examples compare primary colorways with pink and rainbow seasonal versions across square, rounded-square and circular masks.
practical_value: Select a primary or seasonal treatment, then check its crop under the platform’s actual mask.
